def _action(text: str) -> str:
    actions = (
        ("raised", "RAISED"),
        ("lowered", "LOWERED"),
        ("withdrawn", "WITHDRAWN"),
        ("withdrew", "WITHDRAWN"),
        ("withdraw", "WITHDRAWN"),
        ("initiated", "INITIATED"),
        ("maintained", "MAINTAINED"),
        ("narrowed", "NARROWED"),
        ("widened", "WIDENED"),
    )
    for word, action in actions:
        if word in text:
            return action
    return "UNKNOWN"
